tools.description: Create up to 50 tickets and 100 links in one all-or-nothing write. Each ticket has a batch-local `ref`; links join refs and/or existing ids. `templates` repeat one ticket per `for_each` value, e.g. a 20-step chain: {for_each: 20, ref: "s{i}", ticket: {title: "Step {i}"}, links: [{from_ref: "{ref}", to_ref: "{prev}", link_type: "depends_on"}]}. Rejected as a whole, every problem listed, on bad or duplicate refs, unknown ids, self-loops, duplicate links or a cycle. Returns {created: {ref: id}, links, idempotent_replay}; verbose: true echoes every id.

actor_id.description: Acting actor (default: the server --actor). Subagents sharing one server pass their own.

claims.description: Tokens for existing tickets used as from_id.

dry_run.description: Validate only; the result shows the expanded plan.

idempotency_key.description: Replay-safe: a repeat with the same key returns the first result, writes nothing.

items.description: One end each side: *_ref = a ticket in this batch, *_id = an existing ticket (a from_id needs its token in `claims`).

One ticket (+ links) per for_each value. In every string: {i} = 1-based index, {value}, {ref} = this item's expanded ref, {prev} = the expanded ref of item i-1 of this template (a link naming {prev} is skipped for item 1).

for_each.description: Values to repeat over, or a count n (= values 1..n).

ref.description: Ref per item; must use {i} or {value}, e.g. "t{i}".

ticket.description: Fields of a `tickets` entry without ref (title required).

verbose.description: true: return every ticket and link id in full instead of {created, links, idempotent_replay}.

tools.name: sea_apply

plan.description: dry_run only: the expanded plan; links as "from link_type to". {tickets,links}

tools.title: Create tickets and links in one batch

tools.description: Lease tickets, all or nothing. Returns one claim_token per ticket (shown once; every write needs it). Leases (default 900 s, max 3600) renew while you call sea-lite tools. already_claimed names the holder and expiry; re-claiming your own rotates the token. `scope.paths` locks the files you will edit (scope_conflict names the holder, ticket, overlap and expiry). `wait_seconds` waits for a held ticket or scope to free up instead (≤ 300 s; wait_timeout names who still holds it).

actor_id.description: Acting actor (default: the server --actor). Subagents sharing one server pass their own.

lease_seconds.description: Lease seconds (default 900, max 3600); renewed while you keep calling sea-lite tools.

scope.description: What you will edit; scope_conflict if someone else holds an overlapping scope.

paths.description: Repo-relative files or dirs (a dir covers everything beneath), globs, or `.` for the whole repo.

worktree.description: Absolute path of your git worktree; `sea-lite release-worktree` frees the claim when it is removed.

wait_seconds.description: If held by someone else, wait up to this many seconds (≤ 300) for it to free up.

waited.description: Present when the call had to wait: how long, who held it, what freed it. {seconds,attempts,blocked_by,freed}

tools.description: Create one ticket (status idea, or triaged = dispatchable now). Returns it plus `possible_duplicates` (similar titles; the create still happens, you decide). `claim_seconds` also claims it and returns a claim_token.

idempotency_key.description: Replay-safe: a repeat with the same key returns the first result, writes nothing.

status.description: Initial status. `triaged` skips the inbox so sea_next can hand the ticket out immediately.

tools.description: End your work on a ticket in one write: `outcome` done (→ resolved) | blocked (→ blocked, resumable) | abandoned (→ dropped), a required `note` (what shipped / why), optional `commit` sha; your claim is released and all of it is chained. `tickets` finishes several (each with its own claim_token; all or none). No confirmation prompt.

tickets.description: Several tickets (each with its own token) instead of ticket_id + claim_token; all or none.

expected_version.description: Fail with version_conflict unless row_version equals this.

tools.description: Atomically pick and claim the next ticket: unclaimed, triaged or in_progress, assigned to you or nobody, not priority parked, all predecessors (blocks / depends_on) terminal, not an epic (kind epic or parent_of an open child); highest priority, in_progress before triaged, then oldest. A ticket you handed off (sea_release with a note) goes to another agent first. Returns ticket + claim_token, or ticket: null with reason nothing_eligible | held | held_by_stale_claim (held[]: holder, claim age, silence, expiry) | handed_off. This project only. `scope.paths` locks the files you will edit. `wait_seconds` (≤ 300) waits while the scope is held, or while nothing is free but others hold work that may free up.

tools.description: Set status (claim_token). Work track idea → triaged → in_progress → resolved; any active ticket may enter parked | blocked | needs_decision (resume to idea / triaged / in_progress) or a terminal state resolved | wont_fix | duplicate | dropped | merged (no exit; releases the claim; needs confirm: true or the client's confirmation). to=duplicate needs duplicate_of (records a `duplicates` link). `note` appends a note in the same write; `tickets` moves several at once, all or nothing. Rejections carry legal_next.

duplicate_of.description: Required when to = duplicate; also creates a `duplicates` link.
